node_notes.app: This module initializes the test status, vector counters, and comparison results before test processing. firmware/app/app.c calls LOGI after the reset state is initialized.
node_notes.console: This is the VCP console output for the application's startup message. firmware/app/app.h describes runtime reporting through the initialized console, while firmware/utils/logger/logger.h identifies UART/VCP routing as platform-owned.
node_notes.usart: USART2 is the serial interface used for the initialized console path. application/main.c identifies USART2 setup in system initialization and requires basic stdio setup before app_start; no pin bindings are established by these files.
node_notes.boot: This is the STM32 reset entry and hands off to the firmware after startup checks. application/main.c calls mx_system_init, which its comment identifies as setting up USART2, then calls app_start.
node_notes.logger: The logger macros are printf-backed and provide the application's LOGI call. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h documents printf as the backing mechanism and says UART/VCP routing belongs in the STM32 platform.

node_notes.stdio: Basic stdio is initialized after successful system startup so application logging has a configured console. application/main.c calls mx_basic_stdio_init here.
node_notes.start: This step hands execution to the firmware application after system and console startup succeed. application/main.c calls app_start, implemented in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.stdiook: This branch prevents the application from starting if basic stdio setup fails. application/main.c handles that failure with a non-returning loop.
node_notes.state: The application clears status and vector counters and marks every comparison result not run. firmware/app/app.c performs this reset before any test processing.
node_notes.entry: The reset entry begins the checked startup sequence before application code runs. application/main.c calls mx_system_init and enters a non-returning failure loop if it fails.
node_notes.console: This step represents the printf-backed serial-console destination for the startup log. firmware/utils/logger/logger.h documents printf logging and platform-owned UART/VCP routing.
node_notes.halt: This step represents the startup failure loops reached when either initialization call fails. application/main.c contains an empty infinite loop for each failure path.
node_notes.sysok: This branch checks the system initialization result before proceeding to stdio setup. The check and failure behavior are in application/main.c.
node_notes.log: The application emits the startup_state=initialized message after resetting its test state. firmware/app/app.c uses LOGI, which resolves through the printf macros in firmware/utils/logger/logger.h.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Main as Startup entry
  participant System as System initialization
  participant Stdio as Basic stdio
  participant App as Application
  participant Logger as Printf logger
  participant USART2 as USART2 console
  participant Console as VCP console
  Main->>System: mx_system_init
  System-->>Main: SYSTEM_OK status
  alt System initialization failed
    Note over Main: Remain in startup failure loop
  else System initialization succeeded
    Main->>Stdio: mx_basic_stdio_init
    Stdio-->>Main: SYSTEM_OK status
    alt Basic stdio initialization failed
      Note over Main: Remain in startup failure loop
    else Basic stdio initialization succeeded
      Main->>App: app_start
      App->>App: Initialize test status, counters, and comparison results
      App->>Logger: LOGI startup_state=initialized
      Logger->>USART2: printf log output
      USART2->>Console: VCP console output
    end
  end
